title: VOZIQ AI Launches Subscription AI Production Trial to Fast-Track AI Adoption in Subscription-Based Industries
text:
Reston, VA - March 5, 2025 - VOZIQ AI, a leading provider of AI-powered solutions for subscription-based businesses, has announced the launch of a Production Trial program to help subscription businesses test these solutions using real data and prove value before making upfront investment.
The Production Trial is designed specifically for subscription-based, recurring revenue businesses from industries such as pest control, home security and automation, retail energy providers, health and wellness, Internet, telecommunications and media.
During the production trial, subscription business leaders are guided by VOZIQ AI’s solution experts who follow a proven blueprint to streamline AI adoption by eliminating implementation complexities like assessing data sources, identifying high-value use cases, acquiring necessary skills, and creating a business case.
“While interacting with leaders from subscription businesses, we realized that these leaders understand the AI promise but need strategic partners who can help them turn the promise into real business impact. VOZIQ AI’s Production Trial is designed to address this need,” said Dr. Vasudeva Akula, Chief Data Scientist at VOZIQ AI. “The production trial copies our implementation template from several successful implementations which have helped visionary leaders transform their businesses and capture significant enterprise value using AI.”
Once a subscription business signs up for the production trial, they need to provide servers on their preferred Cloud platform. VOZIQ AI team then works with their BI team to identify and extract data sources, set up data pipelines, install VOZIQ AI software and start uncovering real growth opportunities based on real data without having to worry about their data ever leaving their secure environment. From data to intelligence to creating business case – 90% of the workload is handled by VOZIQ AI team during a production trial.
“With the production trial, subscription business leaders get access to our award-winning AI platform, proven solutions and a highly experienced team of AI specialists. The production trail lays a solid AI foundation which allows seamless and quick transition to full-scale enterprise deployment. This cuts time-to-value from years to months. This resonates strongly with ambitious leaders who are looking to initiate AI-driven transformation,” said Suresh Akula, Chief Technology Officer of VOZIQ AI.
For a limited time, VOZIQ AI is offering the production trial at no cost to subscription businesses who are looking to deploy AI for subscription lifecycle use cases such as reducing subscriber churn, optimizing prices, reducing acquisition costs, or growing subscription revenue.
More details are available on VOZIQ AI website at https://voziq.ai/production-trial.
About VOZIQ AI:
VOZIQ AI is a leading provider of AI-powered solutions that help subscription businesses protect and grow their revenue. By leveraging proprietary machine learning models, VOZIQ AI enables these businesses to run data-driven campaigns to reduce subscriber churn, grow revenue, reduce acquisition costs, improve NPS, and maximize customer lifetime value (CLV).
